text: Born in 1999 with a deformed leg, Lee Geum-hwa lives with her grandparents on a remote dog farm, while her twin sister, whose birth was never registered, is kept [locked in a shed in the backyard|wrong|harm done to children]. When locals investigate the shed at night, [snakes crawl out and bite them|images|vermin and creeping things]. Meanwhile Pastor Park, who exposes cults for publicity, [looks into the Deer Mountain Sect|trigger|digging into a mystery] in Gangwon-do, and police find [a young girl's body entombed in concrete|threat|people who kill].
